title: Real C∞ that is not analytic
summary: Classic bump e^{−1/x²} (extended by 0 at 0) is infinitely differentiable on R but Taylor series at 0 is identically 0—does not recover the function. Real differentiability is weak.

title: Holomorphic once ⇒ analytic
summary: Complex differentiability on an open set (holomorphic) implies infinitely differentiable and locally equal to power series (Cauchy integral formula engine). One complex derivative buys infinite smoothness + rigidity.
math: f holomorphic on Ω ⇒ for z in disk, f(z)=(1/2πi)∮ f(ζ)/(ζ−z) dζ and f(z)=∑ a_n (z−z₀)^n.

title: Identity / continuation teaser
summary: Analytic continuation / identity theorem: values on a set with limit point determine the function on a connected domain—popular ‘magic’ of complex analysis. LO6: precise hypotheses matter.
